info.name: NutriPrep API
info.description:
Full request collection for the NutriPrep REST API.

Run the folders in order (or use Collection Runner): Auth stores `token`, `adminToken` and `userId`; create requests store `categoryId`, `recipeId` and `mealPlanId` for later requests. The admin user comes from `npm run prisma:seed` (ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env).

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Grilled Chicken Bowl",
  "description": "High-protein lunch bowl",
  "ingredients": [
    "chicken breast",
    "rice",
    "broccoli"
  ],
  "instructions": "Grill the chicken, cook the rice, steam the broccoli and combine.",
  "calories": 550,
  "protein": 45,
  "carbs": 60,
  "fat": 12,
  "isPublic": true,
  "categoryId": {{categoryId}},
  "authorId": {{userId}}
}

request.description: ADMIN has every permission, including member actions.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Admin Oatmeal",
  "description": "High-protein lunch bowl",
  "ingredients": [
    "chicken breast",
    "rice",
    "broccoli"
  ],
  "instructions": "Grill the chicken, cook the rice, steam the broccoli and combine.",
  "calories": 350,
  "protein": 12,
  "carbs": 55,
  "fat": 7,
  "isPublic": true,
  "categoryId": {{categoryId}},
  "authorId": {{userId}}
}

exec: pm.test("All recipes belong to the category", () => body.data.forEach((r) => pm.expect(r.categoryId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("categoryId")))));

request.description: Recipes in the category with protein at least 25.

exec: pm.test("Every recipe has protein at least 25", () => body.data.forEach((r) => pm.expect(r.protein).to.be.at.least(25)));
pm.test("Created recipe (45 g protein, 60 g carbs, 520 kcal, 12 g fat) is included", () => pm.expect(body.data.map((r) => r.id)).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("recipeId"))));

request.description: Recipes in the category with carbs at least 50.

exec: pm.test("Every recipe has carbs at least 50", () => body.data.forEach((r) => pm.expect(r.carbs).to.be.at.least(50)));
pm.test("Created recipe (45 g protein, 60 g carbs, 520 kcal, 12 g fat) is included", () => pm.expect(body.data.map((r) => r.id)).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("recipeId"))));

request.description: Recipes in the category with calories at most 400.

exec: pm.test("Every recipe has calories at most 400", () => body.data.forEach((r) => pm.expect(r.calories).to.be.at.most(400)));
pm.test("Created recipe (45 g protein, 60 g carbs, 520 kcal, 12 g fat) is excluded", () => pm.expect(body.data.map((r) => r.id)).to.not.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("recipeId"))));

request.description: Recipes in the category with fat at most 10.

exec: pm.test("Every recipe has fat at most 10", () => body.data.forEach((r) => pm.expect(r.fat).to.be.at.most(10)));
pm.test("Created recipe (45 g protein, 60 g carbs, 520 kcal, 12 g fat) is excluded", () => pm.expect(body.data.map((r) => r.id)).to.not.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("recipeId"))));

request.description: Comma-separated presets are combined with AND.

exec: pm.test("Every recipe matches both presets", () => body.data.forEach((r) => { pm.expect(r.protein).to.be.at.least(25); pm.expect(r.calories).to.be.at.most(400); }));
pm.test("550 kcal recipe is excluded", () => pm.expect(body.data.map((r) => r.id)).to.not.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("recipeId"))));
